f_01KXA9ZXBEMFQHJ88DRVHPEB5A.subject: job_scheduled_start_date
f_01KXA9ZXBEMFQHJ88DRVHPEB5A.content: The job is scheduled to start on 2026-10-05.

f_01KXA9ZXBFP1T9ZXP4W5PSZPEP.subject: addition_footprint
f_01KXA9ZXBFP1T9ZXP4W5PSZPEP.content: The addition is a 30'×10' two-story structure: basement-level storage below and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet above.

f_01KXA9ZXBFNZ9EWR322YFSAKW2.subject: foundation_spec
f_01KXA9ZXBFNZ9EWR322YFSAKW2.content: Foundation consists of continuous 12"×12" concrete footings around the perimeter, 4" gravel base, vapor barrier, rebar/mesh reinforcement, and a 4" concrete slab — no CMU or full-height foundation wall.

f_01KXA9ZXBFB17YMZYR846RZQMM.subject: lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXA9ZXBFB17YMZYR846RZQMM.content: One 3-ply 14" engineered LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is required to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is included.

f_01KXA9ZXBFF2A920PER3W8D8N0.subject: windows_spec
f_01KXA9ZXBFF2A920PER3W8D8N0.content: Four windows are specified: three 36"×60" units and one transom window.

f_01KXA9ZXBF3MSXQNCXGE4W063W.subject: exterior_door_count
f_01KXA9ZXBF3MSXQNCXGE4W063W.content: One new exterior door is included in scope.

f_01KXA9ZXBFHQCJDGFY986CV1F7.subject: electrical_subpanel
f_01KXA9ZXBFHQCJDGFY986CV1F7.content: One new 100-amp subpanel is included in the electrical scope.

f_01KXA9ZXBGSX7B4NXH0BDQ8Q1M.subject: elevator_shaft
f_01KXA9ZXBGSX7B4NXH0BDQ8Q1M.content: A future elevator shaft (approximately 4'×4') is framed and a dedicated 120V/30A circuit is provided; the elevator itself is excluded from scope.

f_01KXA9ZXBGXE86FRW5GGVARS1Y.subject: septic_scope
f_01KXA9ZXBGXE86FRW5GGVARS1Y.content: TDEC septic inspection and capacity evaluation is required because the addition adds a master bathroom and primary bedroom; actual septic/grinder remediation costs are excluded from the contract as a future change order.

f_01KXA9ZXBGTRGSYWG4W6Y71FFY.subject: roof_tie_in
f_01KXA9ZXBGTRGSYWG4W6Y71FFY.content: The new 3/12 gable roof ties into the existing 6/12 roof; architectural asphalt shingle is specified to match existing, with fascia, vinyl soffit, seamless gutters, and all required flashing.

f_01KXA9ZXBH5F8D4EWBKN7WCRKB.subject: roof_system_type
f_01KXA9ZXBH5F8D4EWBKN7WCRKB.content: The scope describes the roof framing as 'truss or rafter framed' — no determination between the two is made in the scope document.

f_01KXA9ZXBH2Z7JV383D0GXM0GK.subject: heat_pump_relocation
f_01KXA9ZXBH2Z7JV383D0GXM0GK.content: Relocation of the existing heat pump and its electrical disconnect is included in the site/demo scope.

f_01KXA9ZXBJKM7BN1YCY6E9NQA6.subject: retrofit_items_in_scope
f_01KXA9ZXBJKM7BN1YCY6E9NQA6.content: At least two retrofit items are present alongside the new-construction scope: an existing hallway electrical switch relocation (with drywall patch, prime, and paint) and the existing heat pump relocation.

f_01KXA9ZXBJZSDGSV03YE691JKX.subject: rock_excavation_exclusion
f_01KXA9ZXBJZSDGSV03YE691JKX.content: Rock excavation is explicitly excluded from the contract; encountering rock during excavation triggers a change order.

f_01KXA9ZXBJPNNPD5Y8JM9QWSWT.subject: job_valuation_status
f_01KXA9ZXBJPNNPD5Y8JM9QWSWT.content: No valuation has been set on this job; data.json:valuation is null.
